title: BetterTogether Device Specification
description: Declarative description of a target SoC's CPU core topology and pinning affinity. One file per device under devices/ replaces a hardcoded entry in builtin-apps/conf.cpp. Adding a new SoC should mean dropping a file here, not editing and recompiling C++.

id.description: Device identifier used to look the device up at runtime (e.g. an adb serial like '3A021JEHN02756', or a logical name like 'jetson'). Must match the file stem.

description.description: Human-readable model/notes. Informational only; not used at runtime.

gpu.description: GPU/accelerator descriptor. 'backend' = the GPU compute API the device's accelerator speaks; 'subgroup_size' selects the Vulkan compute-shader variant (warp16/32/64). Transitional: once the Vulkan engine queries VkPhysicalDeviceSubgroupProperties at runtime, subgroup_size becomes informational. Replaces the hardcoded device->warp map in builtin-apps/app.cpp.

backend.description: GPU compute API for this device (NVIDIA -> cuda, everything else -> vulkan).

subgroup_size.description: Subgroup/warp size used to pick the compute-shader variant (e.g. 16 Mali, 32 Adreno/NVIDIA, 64 AMD/some Adreno).

id.description: OS core id passed to sched_setaffinity.

type.description: Performance tier; mirrors ProcessorType / CoreTypeName in builtin-apps/conf.hpp.

pinnable.description: Whether the scheduler may pin a worker thread to this core.
